runtime.host_label: Apple M5 / macOS Docker Desktop / local trial, not Jetstream2

manifest.license: CC-BY-4.0 as declared in model card
manifest.weights: Author-published float32 PyTorch; no training, conversion or quantization

runtime.cold_start_definition: Model load includes torch/transformers imports, tokenizer and weights; first inference is before warmup. Module-entry-to-ready includes asset preparation and 20 warmups, but not preceding module imports/container creation.

dataset.license_status: HF aggregate dataset card says unknown; original task terms require separate verification. Raw test text is not bundled in the repository or exported prediction report.

cpu_definition: Process CPU time / wall time x100; 100% = one core. RSS sampled after every prediction, not true peak.
definition: Isolated synchronous inference HTTP service; one resident CPU model protected by a serial lock. Does not include Campus Notes comment/database/job workflow.
